nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index and navigation guide for the Waggle OS backend-map documentation set, listing the recommended reading order and full file index for all backend-map sections including data model, API contracts, feature map, and subsystem deep-dives. Also explains how to feed the docs into Lovable for a frontend rebuild.

nodes.name: 00-MENTAL-MODEL.md
nodes.summary: Conceptual overview of the Waggle OS architecture for frontend rebuild purposes, covering the layered mental model (agent runtime, memory substrate, dual persistence), the 5-tier monetization model (TRIAL/FREE/PRO/TEAMS/ENTERPRISE), the KVARK funnel, and what POST /api/chat actually does end-to-end.

nodes.name: 07-FRONTEND-REBUILD-GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive frontend rebuild guide targeting Lovable, providing precise API contracts including base URL, auth handshake, fetch wrapper pattern, read-side normalizers, tier gating, all real-time streaming endpoints (SSE + WebSocket), global state and provider patterns, screen-by-screen data contracts, the Hive DS design system tokens, and a prioritized rebuild order with gotchas checklist.

nodes.name: AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Completeness audit of the backend-map documentation set, cross-referencing 65 local route files and 14 cloud route files against documented sections, cataloguing all database tables (14 memory tables + 20 relational tables), connectors, and identifying gaps where route files have real endpoints but no endpoint-level docs.

nodes.name: WAGGLE-BACKEND-VISUAL.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained interactive HTML visualization of the Waggle OS backend architecture, rendering a visual diagram or interactive map of backend components, routes, and relationships for use as a reference during the frontend rebuild.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript — a self-contained visual reference document at 1552 lines.
